starting_events.description: The simulation begins with the hiring process in its initial state: no offer has been prepared, authorized, issued, or discussed with Richard Zheng. All actors are aware of the role's purpose and the candidate's background as of the cutoff.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that, before 2025-07-10T12:00:00Z, the New Media Hiring Lead (with compensation approval from the People and Compensation Partner) actually issued a valid offer to Richard Zheng, and Richard Zheng actually accepted that offer, and the annual base salary in that accepted offer is the minimum among all offers that Richard Zheng would have accepted during the window (i.e., the offer minimizes annual base salary while still being accepted). Resolve NO if no such accepted offer with minimized salary occurs before the cutoff, or if the cutoff is reached without that outcome.
